HEADER.TITLE: Meta Templates
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Manage the WhatsApp Business templates registered with Meta. Browse, filter and inspect each template's structure and approval status here.

SYNC.FAILED: Could not refresh templates from Meta. Please try again shortly.

DETAIL.MEDIA_HEADER_NOTE: Media header ({format}). The actual image / video / document is set at send time.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete template
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}" on Meta? This removes every language variant of this template and cannot be undone. If the template is used by an active campaign, Meta will refuse the deletion.
DELETE.FAILED: Could not delete the template. Please try again shortly.

EMPTY.NO_CLOUD_INBOX: This account has no WhatsApp Cloud inbox connected yet.
EMPTY.NO_TEMPLATES: No templates registered on this inbox yet. Create one on business.facebook.com — full creation flow inside AurisChat is coming soon.
EMPTY.NO_MATCH: No templates match the current filters.

ERRORS.FETCH_FAILED: Could not load templates. Please try again.

NEW.TITLE: New Meta Template
NEW.DESCRIPTION: Compose a new WhatsApp Business template and submit it to Meta for approval. Once submitted it appears in the list as Pending — approval usually takes minutes to a few hours.

FIELDS.NAME: Template name
FIELDS.NAME_HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. Must be unique on this inbox.
FIELDS.HEADER_TOGGLE_HINT: Text only for now (media in the next release).
FIELDS.HEADER_TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Short heading, up to one {{1}} variable
FIELDS.HEADER_HINT_WITH_COUNT: Up to 60 characters, at most one variable. ({count}/{max})
FIELDS.HEADER_SAMPLE: Sample value for the header variable
FIELDS.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Hello {{1}}, your appointment is on {{2}} at {{3}}.
FIELDS.BODY_HINT: Use {{1}}, {{2}}, ... for variables that will be filled at send time.
FIELDS.BODY_HINT_WITH_COUNT: Use {{1}}, {{2}}, ... for variables that will be filled at send time. ({count}/{max})
FIELDS.SAMPLES_DESCRIPTION: Meta requires a realistic example for each variable so reviewers can approve the template.
FIELDS.FOOTER_TOGGLE_HINT: Short static text below the body, no variables.
FIELDS.FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Reply STOP to opt out
FIELDS.BUTTONS_HINT: Up to 3 quick replies OR up to 2 URL + 1 phone.

NEW.SUCCESS: Template submitted to Meta. It will appear as Pending until Meta approves it.
NEW.ERROR_GENERIC: Could not create the template. Please review the fields and try again.

COMING_SOON.MESSAGE: Meta template management will land here soon. For now, keep using business.facebook.com.
